beginning_of_race.jack_morrison_start: And they're off! Look at Jack Morrison, charging out of the gates with that familiar determined sprint. Always the first to lead the charge, even on a track.
beginning_of_race.fareeha_start: Fareeha Amari, my daughter, showing her usual grace and power. Helix Security trained her well, but a mother always sees the raw talent.
beginning_of_race.reinhardt_start: Reinhardt Wilhelm is thundering down the straight. He's not just running; he's carrying the weight of his convictions with every stride.
beginning_of_race.gabriel_start: Gabriel Reyes, a formidable presence even here. One wonders what ghosts he's chasing, even on a clear day in Middletown.
beginning_of_race.hana_start: Hana Song, D.Va, already pushing the limits! That mech training truly translates to raw speed, doesn't it?
beginning_of_race.lena_start: Lena Oxton, Tracer, a blur of motion! Her chronological disassociation may give her an edge, but I prefer a steady pace myself.
beginning_of_race.angela_start: Angela Ziegler, Mercy, running with such precision. She always knows where help is needed most, even in this chaotic start.
beginning_of_race.torbjorn_start: Torbjörn Lindholm might not look like a front-runner, but never underestimate a Lindholm's tenacity. Trust me on that.
beginning_of_race.genji_start: Genji Shimada moves with a newfound peace, yet his speed is undeniable. Zenyatta's teachings have truly calmed his spirit.
beginning_of_race.cassidy_start: Jesse McCree, or should I say Cole Cassidy? Still got that swagger, even on four hooves. Good to see him out here.

mid_race.fareeha_vs_lena: And Fareeha Amari pulls ahead of Lena Oxton! My daughter's focused power against Tracer's playful zip. A real battle of wills there.
mid_race.reinhardt_vs_gabriel: Reinhardt Wilhelm muscles past Gabriel Reyes! The old Crusader's unwavering spirit against Reyes's shadowed fury. Some things never change.
mid_race.hana_vs_mei: Hana Song, D.Va, bursts past Mei-Ling Zhou! Youthful aggression against careful calculation. Speed over strategy, for now.
mid_race.genji_vs_jack: Genji Shimada glides past Jack Morrison! A ninja's precision overcoming a soldier's brute force. Jack might be surprised by that.
mid_race.angela_vs_torbjorn: Angela Ziegler surges ahead of Torbjörn Lindholm! Mercy's swift intervention against the engineer's steady build. Healing the way forward!
mid_race.cassidy_vs_sombra: Jesse McCree, or Cassidy, outmaneuvers Olivia Colomar! Even Sombra finds it hard to hack that kind of frontier intuition.
mid_race.brigitte_vs_doomfist: Brigitte Lindholm bravely takes the lead from Akande Ogundimu! A shieldmaiden's defiance against the Doomfist's raw might.
mid_race.widowmaker_vs_fareeha: Amélie Lacroix, Widowmaker, effortlessly passes Fareeha Amari! A chilling display of efficiency, one my daughter must learn to counter.
mid_race.soldier76_vs_reinhardt: Jack Morrison, Soldier: 76, finds a new gear and overtakes Reinhardt Wilhelm! Experience and tactical grit winning out over raw, charging power.
mid_race.sombra_vs_mei: Olivia Colomar, Sombra, slips by Mei-Ling Zhou! Hacking the odds, as always. Mei will need to secure her data if she wants to catch up.

late_race.final_fareeha_jack: Neck and neck as they approach the final stretch! Fareeha Amari pulls ahead of Jack Morrison by a hair! The new guard challenging the old, with everything on the line!
late_race.final_reaper_reinhardt: Neck and neck as they approach the final stretch! Gabriel Reyes, Reaper, finds a burst of dark energy, pulling ahead of Reinhardt Wilhelm! A desperate, shadowed push against pure resolve!
late_race.final_dva_widowmaker: Neck and neck as they approach the final stretch! Hana Song, D.Va, with a last-second burst of boost, pulls ahead of Amélie Lacroix, Widowmaker! Youthful determination against cold, calculated grace!
late_race.final_genji_cassidy: Neck and neck as they approach the final stretch! Genji Shimada, with a surge of inner peace-fueled speed, pulls ahead of Jesse McCree! The spirit of the ninja surpassing the cunning of the cowboy!
late_race.final_mercy_sombra: Neck and neck as they approach the final stretch! Angela Ziegler, Mercy, pushes past Olivia Colomar, Sombra, by a whisper! A beacon of light shining through the shadows of deceit!
late_race.final_winston_doomfist: Neck and neck as they approach the final stretch! Winston, with a roar of scientific might, pulls ahead of Akande Ogundimu, Doomfist! Intellect and heart triumphing over pure, destructive force!
late_race.final_brigitte_torbjorn: Neck and neck as they approach the final stretch! Brigitte Lindholm, with a shield-like resolve, pulls ahead of Torbjörn Lindholm! The apprentice proving her mettle against the master!
late_race.final_tracer_fareeha: Neck and neck as they approach the final stretch! Lena Oxton, Tracer, blips ahead of Fareeha Amari! Even my daughter struggles to keep up with that unpredictable pace!

finish.fareeha_victory: And Fareeha Amari crosses the finish line! A decisive victory for Amari, truly demonstrating her unwavering commitment to the objective. My daughter, always a champion.
finish.reinhardt_victory: Reinhardt Wilhelm takes the win! A decisive victory for Wilhelm, truly demonstrating the power of a noble heart and an unbreakable will.
finish.soldier76_victory: Jack Morrison, Soldier: 76, takes the checkered flag! A decisive victory for Morrison, truly demonstrating that old soldiers never fade away, they just win races.
finish.dva_victory: Hana Song, D.Va, for the win! A decisive victory for Song, truly demonstrating her competitive spirit and lightning-fast reflexes. GG, D.Va!
finish.fareeha_dominant: Fareeha Amari crosses the finish line, leaving Jack Morrison and Reinhardt Wilhelm in their dust! A truly dominant performance from Amari, showing that the future of Overwatch burns brightly within her.
finish.dva_dominant: Hana Song, D.Va, streaks across the finish line, leaving Mei-Ling Zhou and Torbjörn Lindholm behind! A truly dominant performance from Song, showing that when a gamer sets her mind to win, there's no stopping her.
finish.reinhardt_dominant: Reinhardt Wilhelm crosses the finish line, leaving Brigitte Lindholm and Angela Ziegler behind! A truly dominant performance from Wilhelm, showing that a heart of gold, combined with raw power, is an unstoppable force.

spin_off_stories.middletown_quiet: Middletown. It's quieter than I remember. Less… tension. Perhaps a horse race is exactly what this city needs, a reminder of simpler times.
spin_off_stories.dva_reminds_youth: Looking at Hana Song, D.Va, reminds me of my own youth. The thrill of competition, the drive to protect. Though her battleground is far different from mine.
spin_off_stories.gabriel_past: I wonder if Gabriel Reyes ever truly looks back, or if he's too consumed by the past. This track... it feels like a memory of a life he once knew.
spin_off_stories.jack_twisted_paths: Jack Morrison... Soldier: 76. To think we once led the world, trying to bring peace. Now we race horses in Middletown. Life has a strange way of twisting paths.
spin_off_stories.overwatch_recall: The whispers of a new 'Overwatch Recall' are growing louder. Even here, in the quiet hum of Middletown, you can feel the shift. Will they answer? Will I?
spin_off_stories.brigitte_spirit: Brigitte Lindholm carries so much of her father, Torbjörn, in her spirit. That unwavering loyalty to Reinhardt, that willingness to protect... it's a beautiful thing to witness.
spin_off_stories.amelie_painful_echo: Amélie Lacroix... every glimpse of her is a painful echo. I wonder if any part of the woman Gérard loved still watches this race, or if Talon truly extinguished her light.
spin_off_stories.grand_central: Middletown's Grand Central Station always felt like a hub, a place where paths converged. Fitting, for a race that brings together so many different stories.
spin_off_stories.winston_brilliance: Winston's brilliance knows no bounds. He'd probably analyze every variable of this track, every wind current. It's how he saved us all, time and again.
spin_off_stories.nile_sunset: Some days, I just want to sit by the Nile, watch the sun set. But then I see faces like Fareeha's, or Lena's, or Genji's, and I remember why I chose to stay.

character_appearance_observations.widowmaker_fluid: Amélie Lacroix... Widowmaker. Her movements are disturbingly fluid, a chilling elegance. It's hard to watch.
character_appearance_observations.doomfist_raw_power: Akande Ogundimu, Doomfist, breaking free with raw power. He believes only in strength, and he's certainly showing it.
character_appearance_observations.sombra_angle: Olivia Colomar, Sombra, already looking for an angle, a shortcut. Always thinking ten steps ahead, that one.
character_appearance_observations.mei_conserving: Mei-Ling Zhou, taking her time, conserving energy. A scientist's approach to the track, I suppose.
character_appearance_observations.brigitte_hoofprints: Brigitte Lindholm, following in her father's sturdy hoofprints. That Crusader spirit runs deep in her blood.
character_appearance_observations.torbjorn_engineer: Torbjörn Lindholm surprises everyone, passing Jesse McCree! Don't let his size fool you, that dwarf has an engineering solution for every problem, even a horse race.
character_appearance_observations.fareeha_spark: Fareeha Amari reclaims her position, passing Amélie Lacroix! My girl always fights for what's right, even if it's just the lead in a race. I saw that spark in her eyes.
character_appearance_observations.winston_leap: Winston, with a powerful leap, overtakes Akande Ogundimu! Brains and brawn, a true scientist's breakthrough against the Doomfist's blunt force.

bets.experience_enthusiasm: If I were a betting woman... and I'm not saying I am... I'd put my money on experience over enthusiasm today.
bets.reinhardt_stubbornness: The odds makers didn't account for Reinhardt's stubbornness. That's always been their mistake.
bets.dark_horse: Smart money would be on the dark horse here. Sometimes the quietest runners surprise you.
bets.fareeha_early: Fareeha's showing strong early, but this race is far from over. Never count your winnings before the finish line.
bets.gabriel_long_odds: Gabriel Reyes at long odds? The bookmakers clearly don't know what shadows can accomplish.
bets.hana_popularity: Hana Song's popularity with the crowd is driving her odds down, but popularity doesn't always win races.
bets.torbjorn_longshot: If Torbjörn Lindholm pulls this off, someone's going to make a fortune on that longshot bet.
bets.angela_safe_bet: Angela Ziegler's steady pace makes her a safe bet, but safe doesn't always pay well.
bets.smart_money: The smart money's spreading their bets today. Too many variables, too many wild cards in this field.
